title: Implement retry delays and a circuit-breaker state machine
prompt: Return a retry/circuit-breaker state machine with injected numeric time. allow(now) permits closed requests or ONE half-open probe; record(success,now) closes or counts/reopens failures. retry_delay(attempt,rng) returns full-jitter capped exponential delay. Caller enforces its attempt/deadline budget and classifies retryable errors; no sleeping occurs.
